title: Design a Social Media Feed (like Twitter/X)
description: Design the home timeline/feed service for a social media platform.
requirements: Home timeline shows posts from followed users
hints: Fan-out on write vs fan-out on read — which approach for whom?
The celebrity problem: what happens when someone with 50M followers tweets?
How do you rank the feed? Chronological vs algorithmic?
Think about the data model for the timeline
